items.source: Mime type that can be produced.
items.translation: 可生成的 MIME 类型。

items.source: Can be used with @ReadOperation, @WriteOperation and @DeleteOperation annotations to quickly define a list of produces values.
items.translation: 可与 @ReadOperation`、@WriteOperation` 和 @DeleteOperation` 注解配合使用，以快速定义一组 `produces` 值。

items.source: Producible types can also be injected into operations when the underlying technology supports content negotiation. For example, with web based endpoints, the value of the Producible enum is resolved using the Accept header of the request. When multiple values are equally acceptable, the value with the highest ordinal is used.
items.translation: Producible 类型也可以在底层技术支持内容协商时注入到操作中。例如，对于基于 Web 的端点，Producible 枚举的值是使用请求的 Accept 头解析的。当多个值同样可接受时，使用具有最高ordinal 的值。

items.source: Return if this enum value should be used as the default value when an accept header of */* is provided, or if the Accept header is missing. Only one value can be marked as default. If no value is marked, then the value with the highest ordinal is used as the default.
items.translation: 如果提供了 `Accept` 头为 `*/*`，或者 `Accept` 头缺失时，应返回此枚举值作为默认值。只能标记一个值为默认值。如果没有标记任何值，则使用具有最高 ordinal 的值作为默认值。
